searchLog: 0 verified opportunities — WebFetch egress in this hunt routine's sandbox is restricted to the anthropic.com apex domain only, confirmed by direct test against ~15 unrelated domains (job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, www.databricks.com, stripe.com, jobs.nvidia.com, careers.microsoft.com, www.metacareers.com, sierra.ai, www.ycombinator.com, en.wikipedia.org, www.google.com, example.com, careers.redpoint.com — all getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND), while www.anthropic.com loaded fine on every attempt including a fresh, uncached path. Checked git history: this is not a one-off — every hunt commit since mid-July 2026 (~3 months, every single day, e.g. 2026-09-16 through 2026-10-10) logged the identical egress failure in its commit message, so it is a standing environment restriction, not a transient blip, and it has not been fixed despite being reported daily. Used the one working domain to check Anthropic directly: www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs lists Applied AI Architect (10 US postings: Beneficial Deployments, Commercial, Cyber, Enterprise Tech, Industries, International Policy, Partnerships, Public Sector, Startups, Strategic Enterprise Tech) and 19 Technical Program Manager reqs, all US-based — but target-companies.json's existing verified note already says this team has 'no new-grad pipeline' and comp-band data surfaced via WebSearch ($240k-380k) confirms senior-level, so none clear the new-grad/no-3+-YOE bar; the individual JD pages needed to confirm YOE line-by-line are themselves on job-boards.greenhouse.io, which is unreachable. WebSearch (separate backend, unaffected) surfaced leads for Ramp FDE, Databricks APM, and Sierra APX, but a search snippet is not a page load and the hunt's own rule is explicit that snippets never substitute for verification, so none are included. 0 verified is the correct, honest output today, as it has been for ~3 months straight.

toolOutage.scope: WebFetch resolves only anthropic.com in this routine's sandbox; every other domain tested fails DNS (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND)
toolOutage.persistence: Present in every daily hunt commit since mid-July 2026 per git log of this file — roughly 3 months, unresolved
toolOutage.likelyImpact: src/brief.js falls back to the paid API hunter whenever huntedItems.length is 0 and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, which has likely been true on most/all of these ~3 months — plausibly tied to the Anthropic API spend Dom flagged in life/PIPELINE.md ('crossed $100/mo, worth a look')
toolOutage.fix: Widen the network egress allowlist for this scheduled routine's cloud environment to cover standard job-board domains (job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards-api.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com, lever.co, workday.com, company apex domains) — this is an environment/connector setting, not something fixable from inside the session
